reviews.text: Lucarelli is by far one of the best professors I've ever had! She's extremely compassionate and patient and approachable, so if you're ever feeling lost and confused don't be afraid to go to her! She's also great at answering emails and coordinating times to meet with students. She was extra helpful getting me connected with other faculty members in the MELC department as well, and overall I'd just say that she makes this course a wonderful experience.
reviews.title: Great course!!

MELC 18.sentiment: Students describe a chill survey of Ancient Egypt with light workload and engaging subject matter, though lectures can be dry and fast. Reviews disagree on exams: some find them easy, others say you must memorize over 100 terms. Discussion sections and GSIs are praised.

reviews.text: Great class, Lucarelli is super engaging and excited about the material, which makes it easier to enjoy the lectures. There's one assignment a week which probably takes 1-2 hours to complete, and a couple readings that probably take 2-3 hours total. Overall, I'd say this is a fairly chill class, and fun to take too (if you're into Ancient Egypt).
reviews.title: Fun, chill class
